statement: This sketch creates a futuristic console interface set against a deep space backdrop, evoking the feeling of a sleek, high-tech control panel floating in the void. The design features a dark glass surface with geometric black housing, subtle grid lines, and an internal glow that pulses gently to simulate ambient lighting. A silver glint slowly drifts across the reflective surface, tracing a diagonal path that suggests ongoing activity within the machine. The entire scene is rendered using 2D p5.js primitives without WebGL, maintaining performance while delivering a cinematic quality through careful attention to color gradients, layering, and motion.
